description: `trigger.list` is S20 T8's operational view (pause/resume live in CLI and app only, TR12): every trigger's kind, blueprint, cron and zone, the PAUSED state, and the next fire computed by the SAME library the clock walks — printed, never guessed. Policy NEVER appears here: a plane that cannot evaluate governance must not print its implicit consent; a refusal arrives in the fire record, in S10's own sentence (TestPauseAndTriggerAccessAreDistinct).
